question: Which deities are placed at the upper part of the doorway?
premises: The procedure is attested in the teaching of the Three-headed One and others.
Gaṇeśa and Lakṣmī are worshipped above the doorway.
They are placed on the right and left respectively.
inference: The doorway worship begins above the door with Gaṇeśa on the right and Lakṣmī on the left.
uncertainties: The exact identification of triśiraḥśāsana is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: This procedure is seen in the teaching of the Three-headed One and others. Above the doorway one should worship Gaṇeśa and Lakṣmī, on the right and left, and then continue with those associated with them.
